import importlib,json,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
m=importlib.import_module("docs.superpowers.journals.corr-evidence.b.report_emission_census")
old_ref="680decaa9a1aab96375cedb1fba109d03e460061:policy-engine/schemas/runtime_api_v1.openapi.json"
old=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",old_ref])
new=Path("schemas/runtime_api_v1.openapi.json").read_bytes()
x=m._nodes(json.loads(old,object_pairs_hook=m._unique))
y=m._nodes(json.loads(new,object_pairs_hook=m._unique))
paths=sorted(p for p in x.keys()|y.keys() if p not in x or p not in y or x[p]!=y[p])
prefix=("paths","/api/v1/exports/governed-projections/confidence-ledger-risk-spend","get","responses","200","content","application/json","examples","default","value")
print(json.dumps({"old_ref":old_ref,"current_source_ref":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip(),"old_sha256":hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest(),"new_sha256":hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest(),"denominator":"Every typed JSON node, independently recursive and iterative; absent differs from null","old_nodes":len(x),"new_nodes":len(y),"identity_sets_equal":x.keys()==y.keys(),"changed_count":len(paths),"changed":[{"pointer":"/"+"/".join(q.replace("~","~0").replace("/","~1") for q in p),"old":x[p] if p in x else {"absent":True},"new":y[p] if p in y else {"absent":True}} for p in paths]},indent=2))
assert x.keys()==y.keys()
assert all(p[:len(prefix)]==prefix for p in paths)
